scripts.test:homepage-load: npx cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/hooks/**/*.ts --require tests/e2e/steps/**/*.ts tests/e2e/features/**/*.feature --tags @HomepageLoad
scripts.test:bdd: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('test-results/cucumber-json',{recursive:true})" && npx cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/hooks/**/*.ts --require tests/e2e/steps/**/*.ts --format progress-bar --format json:test-results/cucumber-json/cucumber-report.json tests/e2e/features/**/*.feature
scripts.test:add-well: npx cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/hooks/**/*.ts --require tests/e2e/steps/**/*.ts tests/e2e/features/**/*.feature --tags @AddWelltodashboard
scripts.test:headed: npx cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/hooks/**/*.ts --require tests/e2e/steps/**/*.ts tests/e2e/features/**/*.feature
scripts.test:debug: node --inspect-brk node_modules/.bin/cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require src/hooks/**/*.ts --require tests/e2e/steps/**/*.ts tests/e2e/features/**/*.feature
scripts.test:bdd:report: npm run test:bdd && npm run report
